item.title: CVE-2026-91113: Silverstripe Framework: User-controlled ClassName allows unauthorized record type change
item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Impact A user who can edit a record through a GridField detail form could change the record to an unrelated class, without the permission checks for that class.
### Reported by Lachlan Davidson, Carapace

item.title: CVE-2026-91112: Silverstripe Framework: CMS_ACCESS_SecurityAdmin privilege escalation
item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Impact A user with access to the Security section (CMS_ACCESS_SecurityAdmin) but without the ADMIN permission could edit a group that grants ADMIN through a role or a parent group, and use it to escalate their own privileges.
### Reported by Lachlan Davidson, Carapace

item.title: CVE-2026-88989: Silverstripe Framework: Auth bypass GridFieldDetailForm
item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Impact A CMS user who can edit records through a GridField detail form could create new records without the permission to create them, by sending a save request directly.
### Reported by HDWSec - https://hdwsec.fr

item.title: CVE-2026-88988: Silverstripe Framework: XSS via SVG data URI
item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Impact The HTML sanitiser did not remove SVG data URIs. A CMS author could store content that runs JavaScript in the browser of another user who views it.
### Reported by HDWSec - https://hdwsec.fr

item.title: CVE-2026-88987: Silverstripe Framework: XSS via XHTML data URI
item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Impact The HTML sanitiser did not remove XHTML and XML data URIs. A CMS author could store content that runs JavaScript in the browser of another user who views it.
### Reported by Jack Wallace from Bastion Security

item.title: CVE-2026-128075: Nuxt exposes the message and data of unhandled errors thrown during server rendering
item.description:

item.description:

item.title: CVE-2026-128118: SvelteKit: Build-time server-only module import guard could fail, resulting in server secrets being statically replaced in client bundle
item.description: Severity: high. Under certain circumstances, server-only imports, which typically cannot be included in the client bundle, could make their way into it, potentially exposing secrets. This could only occur when those server-only imports were made through `src/params.js`.

item.title: CVE-2026-128120: SvelteKit: DoS while parsing form data from a remote functions `form`
item.description: Severity: high. This only affects applications using the experimental remote functions flag and utilizing the `form`, `query`, or `command` remote functions. A specially-crafted request could block the event loop for extended periods of time during parsing.

`Application.add_domain()` compiled each `*` in a host mask to `[^:]*`. With two or more wildcards in a mask, matching a long `Host` header that does not match the mask took polynomial time on the event loop.

item.title: CVE-2026-128125: AIOHTTP: Unbounded cookie storage in client CookieJar
item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Summary
`Set-Cookie` parsing created additional cookies from unrecognised `name=value` attributes, and `CookieJar` had no limit on the number of cookies stored or sent. A server could make the client store a very large number of cookies and generate very large `Cookie` headers
